name: vibecheck
description: SomaCheck returns a consented, proposition-specific Aligned or Unaligned reading and model confidence from the person's own phone gesture.

interface.shortDescription: A consented signal when words are the bottleneck.
interface.longDescription: Ask for your own proposition-specific SomaCheck reading through a three-second phone gesture. The result is Aligned or Unaligned with model confidence, measured against your personal baseline.
defaultPrompt: Help me request a SomaCheck vibecheck on a statement I choose.
Check the result of my pending SomaCheck request.
